title: These will never be my go-to glasses.
text: These will never be my go-to glasses.. I'm not  WOW'ed by these glasses by Reidel at all. I own many Reidel products and these don't have the finesse I am used to. You can feel a huge ridge where the stem connects to the bulb. It's very clunky and distracting. The stem is thicker than I am used to. Also, the base is super thick and ugly. I included a picture of the new glass on the left and one of my older reidel glasses on the right. The older one has a fluid, 1 piece, thin base and stem. Over all, these feel like an inexpensive libby-like restaurant wine glass. I'm a bit disappointed.
